Ouozon City http: //www dilo com ph DILG OPINION No. 110 s. 2022 October 3, 2022 HON. ELNIE ARBUNOL Sangguniang Kabataan Chairperson Barangay Cabariuan, Municipality of Sibalom Province of Antique Dear SK Chairperson Arbuöol: This has reference to your letter dated 15 August 2022 requesting for an opinion regarding concurrent vacancies in the positions of President and Vice President in the Pambayan na Pederasyon ng mga Sangguniang Kabataan (SK) and in the Liga ng mga Barangay (LnB), in the Municipality of Sibalom, Province of Antique. Per your letter, the facts and circumstances relating to your queries are as follows: ISt Issue • The two highest positions in the Pambayan na Pederasyon ng mga SK of the Municipality of Sibalom were vacant since July I , 2022. • The Vice President passed away last January 2020 due to an accident. • On the other hand, during the May 9, 2022 National and Local Elections, the Pederasyon President filed his Certificate of Candidacy for the position of Sangguniang Bayan Member, and was proclaimed as winner. 2nd Issue • The Liga ng mga Barangay President in the same municipality was elected as municipal mayor in 2019. • Thereafter, the LNB Vice President assumes the position of President pursuant to the rule of succession. However, the LNB President was elected as Sangguniang Bayan Member during the May 9, 2022 National and Local Elections. • An election was conducted on June 27, 2022 to elect the new LnB President who assumed Office on July I, 2022. As to the first issue, you are now asking this Department whether the concerned Pederasyon has the "means" to conduct a Pederasyon Special Election to fill up the existing vacancies in the above positions. We qualify. "Matlno, Mahusay at Maasahan" Trunkline No.; 8876-34-54

Please be advised in DILG Legal Opinion 63. S. 2022 addressed to Sangguniang Bayan Member Limuel Gabriel B. Donato of San Luis, Aurora, we have already answered the same issue. A copy of said opinion is hereto attached for your reference. Accordingly, we stand consistent with our position therein that concurrent vacancies in the offices of the President and Vice President of the Pederasyon ng mga Sangguniang Kabataan shall be governed by the Internal Rules of Procedures of the concerned SK Pederasyon. This Service opinion therein is quoted hereunder, viz: xxx "Foremost, the existing vacancies in the President and VP Positions should be filled up in accordance with the Intemal Rules of Procedure (IRP) of the Pambayan na Pederasyon ng mga SK of San Lusi, Aurora, pursuant to Item V, Section of the DILG-COMELEC-NYC Joint Memorandum Circular No. 2017-01, viz: "Formulate, and adopt its own Intemal Rules of Procedures (IRP) which shall prescribe a set of rules to serve as guidelines of the Pederasyon Officers and the Committees in the discharge of their official functions, duties and responsibilities, particularly on internal organization; date, time and venue of regular or special session or meeting, parliamentary procedures; payment of pederasyon dues and such other rules and regulations that may be adopted by the pederasyon that are not contrary to existing laws, ordinance, this JMC and other govemment issuances". Special elections as stated in Section 41(a)(4) of the JMC is not applicable in the case at hand as it contemplates a situation where the vacancy is by virtue of the incumbent Vide President's automatic assumption of the position of the President because of the President's resignation, death, incapacity, removal from office or absence without leave. " xxx Therefore, the conduct of the (special) election to fill up the vacancy in the positions of the President and Vice President should be in accordance with the IRP of the Pederasyon ng mga SK pursuant to Item V, Section 23(1)(2) of the said JMC, not the special election as contemplated in Section 41(a)(4) of the subject JMC. Anent the second issue, the succeeding discussion on vacancies and succession in the Liga ng mga Barangay is respectfully presented for guidance. Correspondingly, Article XII, Section 2 of the 2017 Constitution and By-Laws of the Liga ng mga barangay sa Pilipinas, states that: Page 2 of 4

section 2. Vacancies and Succession. In case of a permanent vacancy in the office of the president due to refusal Io assume office, death or removal from office on the grounds provided in section 4 of this article, voluntary resignation, permanent incapacity to discharge the duties and functions of president, or fails to comply with his undertaking executed in accordance with the provisions of article VI, section 1.5 of the Liga Election Code, the executive vice president in the case of the national Liga or the vice president in the case of local chapters, shall assume the office for the unexpired term of the president. Succession shall take take effect only after confirmation by the national executive board in accordance with article 'X, section 2 of the Liga Election Code. The vice president who assumes the position of president by succession shall represent the Liga chapter in the Sanggunian concemed upon representation therein of his certificate of confirmation. The vice president of the provincial chapter shall assume the post of president as provided in the immediately preceding paragraph, provided that he has not been removed or suspended as president of the municipal or component city city chapter concemed. In case of temporary vacancy in the office of the president due to physical or legal reasons such as, but not limited to, suspension from office in accordance with section 3 of this article and other relevant provisions, leave of absence, or travel abroad, the vice president shall assume the office of the president during the period of temporary vacancy, subject to confirmation of the national executive board. In case of vacancy in the office of the vice president in the local chapter or the office of the executive vice president and/or vice presidents in the national Liga, the same shall be filled up through an election among the bona fide and incumbent chapter members. The positions of vice president for Luzon, Visayas, and Mindanao shall be filled up by the members of the chapter originating from their respective geographical areas. Vacancy in any other office need not be filled unless the remaining members of the executive board cannot constitute a quorum. In this instance, the respective general memberships shall convene for elections, as the case may be. Since the LnB President in the same municipality was elected as municipal mayor in 2019, thereafter, the LNB Vice President assumes the position of President pursuant to the rule of succession, and now, the LnB President was elected as Sangguniang Bayan Member during the May 9, 2022 National and Local Elections, we are of the view that special elections may be allowed to fill in the vacancies, provided that, there has to be an authority from the incumbent national executive board pursuant to Section 1, Article Xl of the 2017 Constitution and By-Laws of the LnB sa Pilipinas. Page 3 of 4

withstanding, we would like to stress that this Opinion is being issued without rejudice to any contrary opinion, decisions, and orders of competent authorities or courts. We hope to have assisted you on the matter. Thank you. Respectfully yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY TTY. J IC R.
